nodes.name: Estimate the allowance with the online calculator
nodes.description: The applicant may use Kela's calculator to get an estimate of the allowance; the result is only an estimate.

nodes.name: Submit communal-household power of attorney (AT 5e) with the application
nodes.description: A roommate who represents a communal household completes form AT 5e and submits it with the application.

nodes.name: Notify move to Finland (form Y 77e)
nodes.description: An applicant who has moved to Finland and has not claimed Kela benefits before also completes form Y 77e.

nodes.name: Decide whether a person who moved to Finland is permanently resident
nodes.description: Kela considers whether a person who moved to Finland is permanently resident, which decides whether they can belong to the household.

nodes.name: Report move abroad or stay abroad (form Y 38e)
nodes.description: The applicant tells Kela in OmaKela or on form Y 38e about moving to or staying in another country.

nodes.name: Check whether the landlord sends rental agreement data to Kela
nodes.description: The applicant checks the published list of landlords that send rental agreement information directly to Kela.

nodes.name: Landlord provides rental agreement details to Kela electronically
nodes.description: Certain landlords provide rental housing details to Kela in electronic form, so the recipient need not submit the rental agreement.

nodes.name: Attach a copy of the signed rental agreement
nodes.description: The applicant sends a copy of the signed rental agreement with the application when Kela does not get it from the landlord.

nodes.name: Apply online in OmaKela
nodes.description: The applicant applies for general housing allowance in the OmaKela e-service.

nodes.name: Apply with the combined online form (general social security benefit + housing allowance)
nodes.description: The applicant may use the new online form to apply for general social security benefit and general housing allowance at the same time.

nodes.name: Submit supporting documents in OmaKela
nodes.description: The applicant submits supporting documents in OmaKela, photographing paper documents.

nodes.name: Apply on paper form AT 1e
nodes.description: An applicant who cannot use OmaKela applies on form AT 1e.

nodes.name: Fill in, print and sign the form
nodes.description: The applicant fills in, prints and signs the paper application.

nodes.name: Post the form and supporting documents to Kela
nodes.description: The applicant posts the form and supporting documents to Kela, PL 10, 00056 KELA.

nodes.name: Declare household income (gross) in the application
nodes.description: The applicant states household income at its gross amount, including tax-exempt income.

nodes.name: Notify the Digital and Population Data Services Agency of the change of address
nodes.description: The applicant notifies the Digital and Population Data Services Agency of the new address of all household members within one week.

nodes.name: Consent to payment of the allowance to the landlord
nodes.description: The applicant may consent to Kela paying the allowance directly to the landlord's account.

nodes.name: Inform the applicant in advance of data sources and disclosures
nodes.description: Kela must tell the applicant in advance where data about them may be obtained and to whom it is regularly disclosed.

nodes.name: Process the application
nodes.description: The application must be processed without undue delay (the provision does not name who processes it).

nodes.name: Obtain wage and salary data from the Incomes Register
nodes.description: Kela gets wage and salary information from the Incomes Register and uses it when processing the application.

nodes.name: Request necessary information from authorities, pension bodies, employers, landlords and others
nodes.description: Kela (and the appeal body) may request, free of charge and despite secrecy rules, information needed to decide the case from the bodies listed in 42 § 1 mom.

nodes.name: Inform the applicant before requesting data from financial institutions
nodes.description: Before a request to a financial institution is made, the applicant or recipient must be informed (the provision does not say by whom).

nodes.name: Request data from financial institutions in writing
nodes.description: A request for data from financial institutions must be made in writing.

nodes.name: Send a reminder about missing supporting documents in OmaKela
nodes.description: The applicant gets a reminder in OmaKela if supporting documents are missing (the text does not say who or what sends it).

nodes.name: Ask the applicant for more information
nodes.description: Kela may ask the applicant for more information when needed.

nodes.name: Decide on the information available to Kela
nodes.description: The application can be decided on the information Kela has if the applicant refuses to give the information or explanation required.

nodes.name: Determine income as continuous income or average income
nodes.description: Kela calculates the household income that affects the allowance either as continuous income or as average income.

nodes.name: Calculate the allowance amount
nodes.description: Kela deducts the basic deductible from the housing costs when calculating the allowance; the allowance is 70% of the remaining acceptable housing costs.

nodes.name: Issue a written decision
nodes.description: A written decision is given to the applicant on granting, rejecting, reviewing, terminating or recovering housing allowance (the provision does not name who issues it).

nodes.name: Check decision, amount and payment date in OmaKela
nodes.description: The applicant can check in OmaKela whether Kela has decided, the amount and the payment date.

nodes.name: Notify the State of the month's housing allowance total
nodes.description: Five working days before the payment day Kela must notify the State of the amount of housing allowances payable that month.

nodes.name: State transfers the notified amount to Kela
nodes.description: On the basis of Kela's notification the State pays Kela the notified amount at least one banking day before the payment day.

nodes.name: Pay the allowance monthly to the recipient's or the landlord's account
nodes.description: Kela pays the allowance into the recipient's or the landlord's bank account on the first banking day of the month.

nodes.name: Decide to pay the allowance to the landlord without the recipient's consent
nodes.description: Kela may decide to pay the allowance directly to the landlord without authorisation if the recipient has failed to pay rent for at least two consecutive months.

nodes.name: Contact the recipient before paying the allowance to the landlord
nodes.description: When rent has been left unpaid for two months in a row, Kela contacts the recipient before paying the allowance to the landlord.

nodes.name: Stop paying the landlord at the tenant's request
nodes.description: Payment directly to the landlord is stopped at the tenant's request when there is no longer a ground for it (the provision does not name who stops it).

nodes.name: Landlord notifies Kela that the tenancy ends or the tenant moves out
nodes.description: When the allowance is paid to the landlord, the landlord must notify Kela if the recipient's right of occupancy ends or the recipient moves out.

nodes.name: Withhold retroactive allowance against housing allowance for pensioners already paid
nodes.description: Retroactively granted allowance may be withheld to Kela to the extent it matches housing allowance for pensioners paid for the same period.

nodes.name: Report changes in circumstances
nodes.description: A recipient must notify Kela of changes in the circumstances of the household, such as income or housing costs.

nodes.name: Review the allowance because circumstances changed
nodes.description: The allowance must also be reviewed when one of the changes listed in 27 § 2 mom occurs (income, housing costs, move or tenure, household size or subtenant).

nodes.name: Request termination of the allowance
nodes.description: A recipient who no longer needs the allowance tells Kela to stop it (OmaKela notification, OmaKela message or form AT 6e).

nodes.name: Terminate the allowance
nodes.description: The allowance is terminated on the grounds and from the dates listed in 29 § (the provision does not name who terminates it).

nodes.name: Annual review of the allowance
nodes.description: The amount of the allowance is reviewed when a year has passed since it started or was last reviewed.

nodes.name: Send annual review instructions to the recipient
nodes.description: Kela sends instructions for the annual review to the recipient's OmaKela about two months before the review.

nodes.name: Submit the information for the annual review
nodes.description: The recipient sends the information for the annual review on the general housing allowance application (OmaKela or post).

nodes.name: Temporarily suspend or reduce payment
nodes.description: Payment may be suspended in part or in full if there is good reason to assume the recipient is no longer entitled to all or part of it.

nodes.name: Recover overpaid allowance
nodes.description: Allowance paid without grounds or in too large an amount must be recovered (the provision does not name who recovers it).

nodes.name: Recover the overpayment from another adult household member
nodes.description: If necessary Kela may also recover the overpayment from another household member who was an adult when the overpayment occurred.

nodes.name: Issue a separate recovery decision to a non-applicant
nodes.description: When recovery is directed at someone other than the applicant, that person gets their own recovery decision.

nodes.name: Waive recovery in full or in part
nodes.description: Recovery may be waived if reasonable and not caused by fraud, or if the amount is small.

nodes.name: Recover allowance from the landlord
nodes.description: Allowance paid without grounds may also be recovered from the landlord in the cases listed in 31 § 4 mom.

nodes.name: Appeal in writing to the Social Security Appeal Board
nodes.description: A person dissatisfied with Kela's decision may appeal in writing to the Social Security Appeal Board; the appeal is delivered to Kela.

nodes.name: Rectify the decision when Kela accepts all appeal claims
nodes.description: If Kela accepts all claims in the appeal it must issue a rectification decision.

nodes.name: Forward the appeal and Kela's statement to the appeal body
nodes.description: If Kela does not rectify the decision, it forwards the appeal and its statement to the appeal body within 30 days of the end of the appeal period.

nodes.name: Appeal body handles the appeal
nodes.description: Appeals are handled by the Social Security Appeal Board and the Insurance Court.

nodes.name: Further appeal to the Insurance Court
nodes.description: The Appeal Board's decision may be appealed to the Insurance Court (the provision does not name the appellant).

nodes.name: Remove an erroneous decision and decide again
nodes.description: If a decision rests on clearly wrong or incomplete information, an obviously wrong application of law or a procedural error, Kela may remove it and decide again.

nodes.name: Re-examine a final decision on new evidence
nodes.description: If new evidence appears in a case about a refused or increased allowance, Kela must examine the case again and may grant or increase the allowance.

nodes.name: Annul a final decision and order the case re-heard
nodes.description: On demand of a party or Kela, the Social Security Appeal Board may annul a final Kela decision and order the case to be heard again.

nodes.name: Decide again after a benefit that prevents payment was granted retroactively
nodes.description: If a benefit that prevents payment of housing allowance is granted retroactively, Kela may decide the case again after hearing the party, without their consent.
